defs.def: to ask sb to come to a social event 邀请

ex.s: In the study, 187 people were invited to visit Kettle’s Yard gallery during an exhibition of handmade clay objects.
ex.t: 在这项研究中，187人受邀在手工陶艺品展览期间参观了Kettle's Yard美术馆。

ex.s: In a class discussion, I was invited to explain the meaning of my name.
ex.t: 但其他创造力渠道仍然敞开着：我继续写诗和讲故事。

ex.s: Beautiful year-round, they invite you to enjoy the smallest detail, from the sound of grasses in the gentle wind to the sculpture of odd-looking seed heads.
ex.t: 良好的社会习惯在社会环境中发挥类似作用。

ex.s: We invite you to join us for the coming ARTS FIRST.
ex.t: 我们邀请你参加即将到来的ARTS FIRST。

ex.s: I was invited to a cookout on an old friend’s farm in western Washington.
ex.t: 我受邀去华盛顿州西部一位老朋友的农场参加烧烤聚会。

ex.s: So I was shocked when, not long after the email, Professor Mary Devon, who was running the programme, invited me to observe the work being done in her lab.
ex.t: 所以，在那封邮件之后不久，负责该项目的玛丽·德文教授邀请我去观察她的实验室工作时，我感到非常震惊。

ex.s: I jumped at the chance, and a few weeks later I was equally shocked—and overjoyed—when she invited me to talk with her about potential projects I could pursue in her lab.
ex.t: 我毫不犹豫地抓住了这个机会，几周后，当她邀请我与她讨论我可以在她的实验室里开展的潜在项目时，我同样震惊——而且欣喜若狂。

ex.s: 40   The resulting blank space invites you to revise.
ex.t: 40 由此产生的空白空间邀请你去修改。

ex.s: When the answer, was no, she, declined the ____44____ （invite）.
ex.t: 当答案是否定时，她拒绝了该____44____ （invite）邀请。

ex.s: A month later, Brown invited me to attend the World Youth Wildlife Conference.
ex.t: 一个月后，Brown邀请我参加世界青年野生动物大会。

ex.s: ●Invite 5—10 people so you have a nice selection. ____17____ , and there may not be enough things to choose from; more than that, and it becomes uncontrollable.
ex.t: ●把不同类型的衣服放在房间不同的表面上。____19____。

ex.s: A French medical-imaging technologist-also a hypnotist — was invited to train a few members in the medical-imaging department of the children's hospital.
ex.t: 一位法国医学成像技术员——也是一位催眠师——受邀培训儿童医院医学影像部门的几名成员。

ex.s: To invite him to a party.
ex.t: 邀请他参加聚会。

ex.t: 邀请他参加聚会。

ex.s: I was invited to play with another kid.
ex.t: 我被邀请和另一个孩子一起玩。

ex.s: When he brings his speech to a nice conclusion ,Whaley invites the rest of the class to praise him.
ex.t: 当他把演讲圆满结束时，惠利邀请全班同学表扬他。

ex.s: He invites guest families for her.
ex.t: 他为她邀请嘉宾家庭。

ex.s: In a 2014 study, Elizabeth Dunn, associate professor of psychology at UBC, invited people on their way into a coffee shop.
ex.t: 在2014年的一项研究中，英属哥伦比亚大学心理学副教授伊丽莎白·邓恩邀请了一些正走进咖啡店的人。

ex.s: While famous foreign architects are invited to lead the designs of landmark buildings in China such as the new CCTV tower and the National Center for the Performing Arts, many excellent Chinese architects are making great efforts to take the center stage.
ex.t: 虽然著名的外国建筑师受邀主导中国地标性建筑的设计，如新央视大楼和国家大剧院，但许多优秀的中国建筑师也在努力走向舞台中央。

ex.s: “I don’t think we would have randomly invited him over but we    55    it and the gifts.”
ex.t: 我觉得我们本来不会随便邀请他过来，但我们对（55）它和那些礼物。

ex.s: People tend to lake pride in keeping everything in their street fresh and inviting.
ex.t: 人们往往以保持街道上的一切清新、诱人为荣。

ex.s: When summer came, they will invite their students pick the vegetables!
ex.t: 夏天来了的时候，他们会邀请学生来摘蔬菜！

ex.s: When summer came, they will invite their students pick the vegetables！
ex.t: 夏天到来时，他们会邀请学生来摘蔬菜！

ex.s: Mum: I 2____ (call) Grandma yesterday and invited her to our house this Sunday.
ex.t: 妈妈：我昨天给奶奶打了电话，邀请她这个星期天来我们家。

ex.s: When the food is served, you should wait until you're invited to eat.
ex.t: 当食物端上来时，你应该等到被邀请时才吃。

ex.s: One of your Chinese students invites you to celebrate a traditional festival.
ex.t: 你的一位中国学生邀请你庆祝一个传统节日。

ex.s: They were grateful to him and invited him to visit.
ex.t: 他们对他心存感激，邀请他去拜访。

ex.s: A friend calls and invites you on an adventure to explore a new town.
ex.t: 一个朋友打电话邀请你去冒险探索一个新城镇。

defs.def: to ask sb formally to go somewhere or do sth （正式）邀请，请求，要求

ex.s: Second, if other factors such as technology remain constant, economic growth and material expectations will fall well below recent standards and this could invite trouble.
ex.t: 其次，如果技术等其他因素保持不变，经济增长和物质期望将远低于近期标准，这可能引发麻烦。

defs.def: to make sth, especially sth bad or unpleasant, likely to happen 招致（尤指坏事）
to ask sb to come to your home after you have been somewhere together （一起相处后）邀请某人回自己家
to ask sb to come to your home a second time, or to ask sb to come to your home after you have been to theirs 邀请再访（或回访）

ex.s: Cobb, for her party, started to ask conference organizers who invited her to speak ___42___ she could do so remotely; about three-quarters of ___43___ time, they agreed.
ex.t: 就Cobb而言，她开始邀请她发言的会议组织者___42___她是否能够远程发言；大约有___43___三分之四的时候，他们同意了。
